content.text: I found the answer. The search result clearly states that **ferrierite** is named after Canadian geologist Walter Frederick Ferrier and "has one of the smallest densities of zeolites (2.1)".
Done. The answer is **Ferrierite** - a rare silicate zeolite named after Canadian geologist Walter Frederick Ferrier (1865-1950), which has one of the smallest densities among zeolites (~2.1 g/cm³).
